This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

  • 100% remote with flexible hours

  • Real ownership and strategic input
  • Supportive, async-friendly team culture

title: Consultor(a) SAP EWM - Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.

Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.

Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Requisitos

  • Experiência como Consultor SAP EWM nível Pleno ou Sênior.
  • Participação em pelo menos um projeto de implementação E2E em SAP EWM
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos logísticos, inbound, outbound, picking, packing, slotting, WM–EWM integration e funcionalidades avançadas.
  • Vivência em migração de dados para projetos SAP, incluindo análise, preparação e validação das cargas.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva, conduzindo mapeamento de processos, definição de requisitos e suporte à implementação.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente para interação com times globais.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como consultor responsável pelo módulo EWM dentro do projeto de migração do Aspire.
  • Realizar mapeamento, análise e validação de objetos de migração relacionados a processos logísticos.
  • Apoiar todas as fases de migração: mock loads, testes integrados, reconciliações e validações pós-carga.
  • Definir fluxos funcionais, regras de negócio e ajustes necessários conforme a arquitetura do S/4HANA.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times funcionais, técnicos e equipes globais do cliente.
  • Criar e manter documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Contribuir com melhorias e recomendações técnicas ao longo do ciclo de projeto.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração SAP (Migration Cockpit, LSMW, BTP).
  • Vivência em ambientes complexos de logística avançada ou indústria com operações críticas.
  • Conhecimento complementar em TM, MM ou integrações logísticas.


Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais, com atuação predominantemente remota.

Regime de contratação: CLT.



Juntos, adaptamos sua profissão ao longo de sua jornada. Desde horários de trabalho flexíveis até responsabilidades profissionais ajustáveis e assistência em situações pessoalmente desafiadoras, entendemos e apoiamos o equilíbrio entre sua vida e seu trabalho.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: COORDENADOR DE VENDAS - DOBON
description:
Somos a Lactalis Brasil !


Fazemos parte do Grupo Lactalis, empresa líder mundial no setor de laticínios, presente em mais de 100 países. O leite está em nossa essência — e é ele que nos conecta às grandes marcas que fazem parte da vida dos brasileiros, como Président, Parmalat, Galbani, Itambé, Batavo, Chamyto, Chambinho, Chandelle, entre outras. Do campo à mesa, cada etapa é conduzida com dedicação, orgulho e amor pelo que fazemos, porque sabemos que nossos produtos carregam a confiança de milhões de famílias.


Acreditamos que o nosso jeito de ser é o que faz a diferença todos os dias. Por meio da Ambição , do Engajamento e da Simplicidade dos nossos 13 mil colaboradores , transformamos desafios em oportunidades e buscamos a excelência em cada fase do processo produtivo. É isso que nos une e nos impulsiona a seguir em frente, sempre com orgulho do que construímos juntos.


Se você também quer fazer parte dessa jornada e ajudar a nutrir o futuro com a gente , candidate-se!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para ocupar a posição de COORDENADOR DE VENDAS - DOBON para trabalhar em Belém/Pará.


Será responsável por:


  • Responsável por coordenar, desenvolver e acompanhar a equipe de vendas na região do Norte,
  • Garantir a execução das vendas do DOBON nos canais prioritários: varejo, atacarejo e distribuidoras.
  • Assegurar a correta exposição, precificação e giro do produto nos PDVs.
  • Monitorar indicadores de vendas, ruptura, estoque, positivação e cobertura de mercado.
  • Desenvolver ações regionais para alavancar sell-in e sell-out.
  • •Realizar visitas nos principais clientes, fortalecendo relacionamento e entendendo oportunidades locais.
  • Acompanhar negociações, apoiar o time em fechamentos e garantir boa execução do produto;
  • Fazer interface com Marketing, Trade e Logística para assegurar abastecimento e execução das iniciativas.
  • Elaborar relatórios de resultado e planos de ação.


Pré-requisitos/Perfil:


  • Ensino superior completo em ADM, Gestão Comercial, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia como Supervisor ou Coordenador de Vendas, preferencialmente no segmento alimentício ou de bens de consumo.
  • Vivência em commodities será um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento do mercado de Manaus e região metropolitana.
  • •Habilidade em liderança, negociação, planejamento e gestão de indicadores.
  • CNH categoria B e disponibilidade para viagens
  • Residir em Belém/PA

title: Product Manager Senior | Banking
description:
Modelo de trabalho:

Modelo de trabalho remoto para pessoas de outros estados, fora de SP;

Modelo de trabalho híbrido para quem morar em SP;


Sobre o time:

Nosso time é responsável pela gestão da Conta Digital e Banking. Trabalhamos no modelo de Squad com autonomia e prezamos pela integração e colaboração.


Desafios da posição:

Como Senior Product Manager na Squad de Banking, você será a força motriz por trás da estratégia e evolução dos nossos produtos financeiros centrais. Sua missão será aprofundar o entendimento sobre as dores e necessidades dos nossos clientes, traduzindo esses insights em um roadmap de produto visionário e executável.

Você irá colaborar intensamente com times de engenharia, design, marketing e operações para construir e otimizar funcionalidades que encantem nossos usuários e impulsionem o crescimento da Conta Simples.

Atuará no dia a dia da squad coordenando os ritos e seguindo os frameworks.


Seu dia a dia na Conta Simples:


  • Estratégia e Visão de Produto: Definir e comunicar a visão estratégica para a Squad de Banking, alinhada aos objetivos da empresa e às necessidades do mercado.
  • Roadmap e Priorização: Desenvolver e gerenciar o roadmap da squad, utilizando frameworks de priorização para garantir o foco nas iniciativas de maior impacto.
  • Discovery e Pesquisa: Liderar o processo de discovery contínuo, conduzindo pesquisas com usuários, análise de mercado e de dados para identificar oportunidades e validar hipóteses.
  • Especificação e Alinhamento: Traduzir a estratégia de produto em requisitos claros e detalhados, escrevendo estórias de usuário e garantindo o alinhamento com a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Produto: Acompanhar todo o ciclo de vida do produto, desde a concepção até o lançamento e iteração, garantindo a entrega de valor contínua.

Aqui, você encontra excelentes oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira.

▶️Plano de Carreira: Hoje, a maioria do corpo diretivo e gerencial são de profissionais formados em nossos quadros.


Se o novo te desafia e o conhecimento te inspira, faça parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolvimento e Codificação PHP: Responsável pela codificação, manutenção e testes do módulo Administração local SEI-Cidades.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Desenvolver e dar manutenção no serviço WsSEI e implementar a inclusão do SEI! Cidades no IntegradorSP (serviços que frequentemente demandam desenvolvimento de APIs ou Web Services).
  • Atualização e Controle de Versões: Gerenciar e executar a atualização da versão SEI Cidades para 4.1.5, garantindo a manutenção e controle das versões em ambientes produtivos e de homologação.
  • Análise de Incidentes: Atuar na análise e correção de incidentes/erros de alta complexidade (Nível 3) no ambiente de produção.
  • Apoio Técnico Especializado: Prestar apoio técnico especializado na solução de problemas complexos que envolvam a tecnologia IBM Java Websphere utilizada no ambiente, atuando como elo entre o desenvolvimento PHP e a infraestrutura Java/Websphere.
  • Suporte a Plataformas: Apoiar a equipe técnica de sistemas no gerenciamento e manutenção do AVA (Moodle) e em chamados ITSM relacionados a problemas de código ou integração das plataformas.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • PHP
  • Moodle
  • Worpress
  • Formação Acadêmica : Superior Completo em Tecnologia

title: Analista de Sistemas Pleno (OIC / SQL)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Analista de Sistemas Pleno (OIC / SQL) será responsável por:

  • Atuar na análise, correção e evolução das integrações desenvolvidas no OIC
  • Monitorar fluxos integrados, identificar erros, realizar troubleshooting e garantir reprocessamentos adequados
  • Trabalhar com consultas, análise e manipulação de dados utilizando SQL
  • Desenvolver, ajustar e manter relatórios OTBI para apoio às áreas de negócio
  • Apoiar sustentação técnica dos módulos do Oracle Fusion integrados ao negócio
  • Realizar depuração técnica para identificação de causas raiz
  • Colaborar com fornecedores e áreas internas para implementação de melhorias e correções
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica de integrações, mapeamentos, relatórios e soluções
  • Suportar demandas de incidentes e requisições conforme SLA


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e manutenção de relatórios OTBI
  • Vivência com integrações REST/SOAP, JSON/XML
  • Experiência em análise de logs, troubleshooting e leitura de payloads
  • Capacidade de entender fluxos sistêmicos e modelagem de integrações


Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com Oracle Fusion (Finance)
  • Experiência com APIs, WebServices e autenticações
  • Noções de mapeamento de dados e integrações.


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

Job Title: Workday Project Manager / Business Analyst

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Contract (PJ)


About Smart IT Frame:

At Smart IT Frame, we connect top talent with leading organizations across the USA and LATAM. With over a decade of staffing excellence, we specialize in IT, healthcare, and professional roles, empowering both clients and candidates to grow together.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and coordinate release activities, Agile ceremonies, and sprint planning.

• Perform data analysis and translate findings into actionable insights.

• Work independently on CCB and Studio integrations in Workday HCM space , including payroll and end-to-end support.

✔ Strong Workday configuration and business process setup knowledge

✔ Proven experience with production support, enhancement management, and Agile delivery

✔ Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills

✔ Exposure to CCB, Studio integrations, and payroll support


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Programa Trainee Inetum Brasil – SAP
description:
Programa de Trainee Inetum Brasil – SAP (Jan/2026)


A Inetum é um grupo global de serviços de TI presente em mais de 19 países, com aproximadamente 24.000 colaboradores. No Brasil, reúne mais de 350 profissionais e integra uma rede de 1.800 colaboradores na América Latina. Fundada na Europa, consolidou-se como referência em consultoria e soluções digitais, apoiando organizações a aproveitarem a capacidade de se adaptar continuamente às transformações tecnológicas e às demandas do mercado.


Objetivo do Programa

Formar jovens talentos para atuar na área de consultoria SAP, desenvolvendo competências técnicas e comportamentais nos módulos MM, FI, SD, PM e PS, com foco em inovação, colaboração e excelência na entrega de projetos.


Estrutura

• Início: Janeiro de 2026

• Duração: Programa de desenvolvimento contínuo

• Formato: 100% remoto

• Regime: CLT


Etapas


1. Seleção (Dezembro/2025)

• Inscrições online

• Avaliação de currículo

• Dinâmica de grupo

• Entrevista técnica com especialistas SAP


2. Onboarding (Janeiro/2026)

• Integração cultural e apresentação da Inetum Brasil

• Introdução às práticas e valores da empresa


3. Formação Técnica (Janeiro–Março/2026)

• Treinamentos em metodologias ágeis e soft skills

• Capacitação intensiva nos módulos SAP: MM, FI, SD, PM e PS

• Workshops práticos com simulações de projetos reais


4. Experiência em Projetos (Março–Dezembro/2026)

• Participação em projetos reais sob supervisão de consultores seniores

• Rotação entre diferentes módulos para ampliar a visão sistêmica


5. Avaliação Final (Dezembro/2026)

• Feedback 360° (mentores, gestores e colegas)

• Possibilidade de promoção para Consultor Júnior SAP


Perfil do Candidato

• Recém-formados ou estudantes em fase final de graduação em Administração, Engenharias, TI, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês intermediário/avançado (desejável)

• Interesse em tecnologia e consultoria SAP

• Boa comunicação, proatividade e espírito de equipe

• Desejável conhecimento básico em SAP, seja por experiência como key user ou por participação em academia de formação.


Benefícios

• Contratação CLT + benefícios;

• Trabalho 100% remoto

• Plano de carreira estruturado

• Treinamentos contínuos em SAP

• Mentoria com profissionais experientes

title: Senior QA Automation Tester
description:
Senior QA Automation Tester

Are you looking to join a highly regarded IT development firm? 


Well, look no further! WebCreek is hiring a skilled QA Automation Tester with 5+ years of experience and a high level of English to work remotely from Latin America.


We’re seeking a QA Analyst with a strong quality-first mindset to help us deliver exceptional software. While experience with test automation is highly valued, we’re equally interested in someone with a solid QA foundation who’s eager to expand their automation and programming skills.


What You'll Do

  • Design and execute manual and automated test strategies for web, mobile, and desktop applications in an Agile environment.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript.
  • Perform exploratory, sanity, smoke, regression, and integration testing; log and track defects in the defect management system.
  • Conduct backend database testing in Microsoft SQL, validating stored procedures, jobs, and triggers.
  • Map requirements to test cases to ensure full coverage and report test results (pass/fail).
  • Create clear, reproducible bug reports and assist the Support team in reproducing client-reported issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure deliverables meet functional and design specifications throughout the SDLC.


What You Have


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Analyst
  • Experience with test automation tools such as Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated tests.
  • Strong skills in executing manual test cases
  • Experience in testing web, mobile, and desktop applications, including cross-browser compatibility testing and related tools
  • Knowledge of Quality Assurance best practices
  • Broad understanding of quality control and testing within the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • High level of English, both spoken and written, to communicate effectively with international teams.
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Experience with Azure DevOps is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field


What You'll Gain

  • A full-time position with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Competitive salary with regular performance-based reviews.
  • Access to top-tier benefits and professional development programs.
  • In-house IT training and industry-recognized certifications.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.
  • Health care expense sponsorship to support your well-being.
  • Fitness sponsorship to help you stay active and healthy.
  • Work with top global brands and industry-leading companies.
  • A collaborative international team with opportunities to work abroad.


Who We Are


WebCreek provides world-class software development teams and technical staff augmentation to Fortune 500 companies and other global industry leaders. With over 29 years of experience and a global presence spanning 20+ offices across North America, Latin America, Asia, and Europe, we deliver top-tier digital solutions to the companies that power the world.


WebCreek is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.


Find out more about our job opportunities:

title: GESTOR DE MARKETING E DADOS
description:
RESPONSABILIDADES:
  • Gerenciar a performance operacional de todos os parceiros terceirizados de backend (SalesBound, Logicall, HelpGrid, etc).
  • Garantir que os dados estejam sendo recebidos e enviados corretamente, com integridade e consistência.
  • Estabelecer e manter rotinas de calls semanais com os parceiros, com foco em performance.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias nos processos de backend com base em KPIs, dados e feedback das áreas envolvidas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico para auditar e corrigir integrações e fluxos de dados.
  • Estruturar e monitorar os principais KPIs de backend, com foco em lucro por lead.
  • Colaborar com os times de SMS, E-mail, Amazon e novos canais, dando suporte ao acompanhamento de métricas e análises.
  • Contribuir na estruturação e formalização dos processos internos e rotinas operacionais.
  • Acompanhar e garantir a evolução de projetos como dashboards, investigações de chargeback, estruturação de novos canais e auditorias.
QUALIFICAÇÕES:
  • Inglês fluente para conduzir reuniões com fornecedores externos;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e pessoas ;
  • Capacidade de liderança e organização de times operacionais ;
  • Experiência com criação e estruturação de processos internos.
  • Experiência prévia com backend em marketing digital ou áreas operacionais similares;
  • Conhecimento de rotinas de integração, webhooks e auditoria de dados;
  • Capacidade de relacionamento com fornecedores e times técnicos;
  • Entendimento sólido de KPIs operacionais (como ROI, lucro por lead, taxa de conversão);
  • Experiência com acompanhamento de performance de parceiros externos;
  • Experiência com CRM, Looker Studio, planilhas e ferramentas de gestão de dados;
COMPETÊNCIAS:
  • COMUNICAÇÃO ASSERTIVA
  • LIDERANÇA OPERACIONAL
  • ANÁLISE DE DADOS
  • COBRANÇA E RIGOR DE EXECUÇÃO
  • PROATIVIDADE E RESOLUÇÃO DE PROBLEMAS
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO E DOCUMENTAÇÃO
SALÁRIO:
  • Ser negociado 
TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.

COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:
  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of professional full stack software development experience to join our U.K. / U.S. client. You will help build the foundation of the client's back-end and data systems. The role will focus on platform development using Supabase, TypeScript, and modern web frameworks, enabling robust data pipelines, operations automation, and API integrations that support the client's growing applications.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and extend back-end systems using Supabase, leveraging database, auth, and edge function capabilities
  • Develop and maintain TypeScript-based APIs and integrations that underpin the client's platform and data services
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to deliver end-to-end features and performant, user-facing experiences
  • Contribute to the evolution of the client's internal automation tools and data pipeline implementations
  • Work closely with product, data, and AI teams on new integrations from analytics and forecasting to blockchain-enabled features
  • Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability while maintaining lightweight, maintainable systems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in full stack or back-end development with strong proficiency in TypeScript
  • Practical experience with Supabase (preferred) or NextJS, Express, or other TypeScript frameworks
  • Solid understanding of API design, database schema design, and serverless architecture patterns
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working independently in Agile, distributed teams
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with AI or ML integrations at the application level
  • Knowledge of blockchain, digital asset verification, or sustainability data systems
  • Experience with data visualization, analytics tools, or geospatial data


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow – Especialista em ITAM (HAM)
description:
A ADOX Tech continua expandindo suas capacidades na gestão inteligente de ativos

corporativos, entregando soluções robustas e sustentáveis para nossos clientes. Buscamos

um Desenvolvedor ServiceNow com sólida experiência em ITAM, especialmente no

módulo HAM (Hardware Asset Management), para fortalecer nosso time e elevar o nível

de governança de ativos.


Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter processos de gestão de ativos de hardware utilizando a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Garantir a integridade, precisão e confiabilidade dos dados de ativos na CMDB, incluindo relacionamentos e atributos.
  • Construir e atualizar inventários de ativos, corrigir dependências e desenvolver dashboards dedicados ao HAM.
  • Integrar o ServiceNow com ferramentas de inventário como SCCM, JAMF, Tanium, Intune, entre outras.
  • Desenvolver e configurar workflows, business rules, relatórios e automações no módulo HAM.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas fornecendo informações completas e

consistentes sobre o estate de hardware.

  • Colaborar com Procurement, Financeiro, Segurança, Infraestrutura e Operações para garantir o ciclo de vida completo dos ativos (request → deploy → manutenção → decommission).
  • Atuar na sustentação técnica do módulo ITAM, garantindo conformidade, performance e boas práticas.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada com ServiceNow, com foco em ITAM/HAM.
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em CMDB, relacionamentos e governança de dados.
  • Experiência com integração de ferramentas de inventário e automação de processos relacionados ao estate de hardware.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados, construção de relatórios gerenciais e monitoramento de KPIs de ativos.
  • Familiaridade com ITIL e melhores práticas de gestão de serviços.


Diferenciais


  • Certificações CSA, CIS-ITAM, CAD ou correlatas.
  • Experiência com SAM/SAM Pro e processos de software asset management.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com grande volume de endpoints.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de compliance e auditoria de ativos.


O que oferecemos


  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos de gestão de ativos em larga escala.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e orientado à excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento acelerado dentro de uma consultoria referência em ServiceNow no Brasil.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

title: Graphic Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


What we're looking for


We’re looking for a Graphic Designer who’s skilled in UX/UI design, with a sharp eye for layout, consistency, and visual storytelling. If you're someone who can take a creative brief and turn it into sleek, conversion-friendly assets that speak to a SaaS audience — we want to hear from you.

You’ll collaborate with our design and content teams to create assets that live across websites, social, decks, and beyond.


What you'll do


  • Design branded visuals for SaaS startups (one-pagers, pitch decks, social ads, case studies, etc.)
  • Work on presentation design, marketing collateral, and internal brand materials
  • Apply consistent visual systems across different formats and platforms
  • Collaborate with Product Designers, Copywriters, and Founders to translate ideas into clean, strategic visuals
  • Create and refine brand identities when needed (logo, color, typography, etc.)
  • Support UI/Web design tasks with visual assets (icons, illustrations, mockups)
  • Deliver assets quickly, adapt based on feedback, and iterate fast
  • Requirements:Strong portfolio with examples of branding, marketing, and presentation work
  • Proficiency in Canva, Figma, Illustrator, or Photoshop
  • Experience designing for SaaS or B2B audiences
  • Understanding of modern design trends, visual hierarchy, and conversion principles
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with direct feedback loops
  • Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to have


  • Experience designing websites in Webflow or Framer
  • 5+ years as a graphic designer
  • Animation skills (e.g., Lottie, After Effects)
  • Knowledge of performance design (A/B testing, CRO, etc.)
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and ad formats


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Graphic Designer with a passion for creating clean and functional designs, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: JDE Developer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


JDE Developer

Position Summary:

The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation , initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other Gallagher applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Skills Required:

• Technical experience of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Advanced in Spanish/Advanced English


Desired:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Technology project support experience

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills


Work Traits:

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Ability to work at a fast pace and cope with conflicting deadlines

• Proven ability to deliver excellent customer service

• Good analytical and problem solving skills

• Strong attention to detail


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Salesforce Administrator (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote Salesforce Administrator with 3-5 years of Salesforce administration experience to join our U.S. client's team. You will work 10 to 15 hours per week supporting the ongoing development, configuration, and management of Salesforce across the Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Service organizations. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, a keen analytical mind, and the ability to drive business outcomes through platform optimization and insightful data analysis.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-organizational teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce environment, ensuring data integrity, system stability, and optimal performance
  • Configure, customize, and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, page layouts, and other settings to support business processes
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce Flows, reports, and dashboards to provide actionable insights and improve user productivity
  • Design and implement new features or system enhancements
  • Manage integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms, ensuring data consistency and seamless functionality
  • Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and documentation for new configurations, automation, and system updates
  • Monitor and manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and security settings in accordance with company policies
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices; recommend improvements and lead adoption of new capabilities
  • Provide user support, training, and documentation for more effective system usage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3-5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator in enterprise, B2B environments
  • Proficiency in Salesforce setup and configuration
  • Solid understanding of CRM principles and Salesforce best practices
  • Experience in Sales Cloud and Salesforce Flow development, reporting, and dashboard creation
  • Experience with integration tools and third-party platforms
  • Ability to review, design, and test new features and customizations independently
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to continuous learning as well as staying current with platform updates
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or a related field
  • Certification as a Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Gestor de marketplace - iFood
description:
A IS é uma assessoria de marketing especializada em fazer restaurantes venderem mais em diferentes fontes de vendas. Aqui, dados viram decisões, e cada ajuste no cardápio precisa aparecer no caixa do cliente.

Daremos preferência para pessoas sem experiência que estão dispostas a aprender. Então se você quer crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!


O que esperar da nossa parceria


  • Clareza e transparência nas metas e rotinas.
  • Trabalho colaborativo, com feedbacks diretos e constantes.
  • Ambiente horizontal, com autonomia e responsabilidade.
  • Foco em resultado real: ticket médio, recorrência e ROAS.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de iFood (Júnior) para integrar a nossa operação de food service. Se você tem olhar analítico, organização de processos e vontade de aprender rápido, essa vaga é pra você!


Principais responsabilidades


  • Engenharia de cardápio: aplicar nossa metodologia, adicionar produtos solicitados por clientes e outras alterações de cardápio
  • Gestão de alavancagens: criar e controlar campanhas, com meta e ROI.
  • Operação e SLA: monitorar cancelamentos e atrasos; alinhar com o cliente para manter níveis positivos.
  • Reputação: responder avaliações com a ajuda de um copywhriter
  • Relatórios semanais: enviar resumo padrão com principais métricas, aprendizados e próximos passos.
  • Pesquisa Mercadológica
  • Outras demandas relacionadas à plataforma
  • Suporte e governança: abrir/acompanhar chamados no iFood quando necessário e manter histórico das mudanças.


Requisitos


  • Noções de funil de vendas para delivery e KPIs: ticket médio, taxa de conversão, cancelamento, preparo e avaliação.
  • Escrita clara e tom humanizado para responder clientes com objetividade.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e disciplina de rotinas.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com hamburguerias, pizzarias, sushi, açaí e outros.
  • Experiência com ClickUp e Reportei ou dashboards similares.
  • Portfólio com antes/depois de cardápios e resultados (prints).
  • Experiência (mesmo que breve) com Gestão de Loja no iFood: cardápio, promoções, taxas de entrega e configurações operacionais.


O que oferecemos


  • Acesso à metodologia e trilhas internas da IS, além de cursos esternos.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e 100% orientado a dados.
  • Plano de crescimento com metas claras e gestão meritocrática.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo e contato direto com cases reais.

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


Contract Type


Full-time

title: Senior Back-End Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software experience, including API and domain model design as well as JavaScript and Node.js development, to join our U.S. client's Platform Engineering team. The ideal candidate will design, build, and deliver high-quality, performant back-end services that power a world-class compliance and trust automation platform. The Platform Engineering team focuses on core components, such as authentication, RBAC, data architecture, and back-end infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability across the product suite.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our clients take the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy to a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their effectiveness against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Build services and APIs in JavaScript and Node.js
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles and implement them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of back-end software development experience designing APIs and domain models with knowledge of JavaScript and Node.js
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols, such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with debugging and performance testing
  • A focus on delivering value and being action-oriented
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter. Think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual, no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Chrome extensions that meet product and user requirements
  • Integrate Chrome Extension APIs to create seamless user experiences and efficient browser functionality

  • Stay current with evolving Chrome APIs and web development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of proven experience developing and publishing Chrome extensions
  • Solid understanding of Chrome Extension architecture and APIs (e.g., Manifest v3, background scripts, content scripts, messaging, and permissions)
  • Experience building interactive front-end components with .js
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Ability to write clean, modular, and maintainable code
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and modern web development workflows
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Experience with Node.js

We are looking for a remote Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension) to develop and publish Chrome extensions for our U.S. client. The duration of this project will last 3-6 months with the opportunity to extend into a full-time position.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively implement formal security and privacy programs, measure the effectiveness of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Chrome extensions that meet product and user requirements
  • Integrate Chrome Extension APIs to create seamless user experiences and efficient browser functionality
  • Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to ensure smooth data flow and consistent UI/UX
  • Debug, test, and optimize extensions for performance, compatibility, and scalability
  • Manage the full lifecycle of Chrome extensions, including publishing, version control, and updates in the Chrome Web Store
  • Stay current with evolving Chrome APIs and web development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of proven experience developing and publishing Chrome extensions
  • Solid understanding of Chrome Extension architecture and APIs (e.g., Manifest v3, background scripts, content scripts, messaging, and permissions)
  • Experience building interactive front-end components with .js
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Ability to write clean, modular, and maintainable code
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and modern web development workflows
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Experience with Node.js


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby on Rails to join as a core member of our U.S. client's tight-knit, experienced engineering team. In this role, you will play a leadership role as well as actively contribute to strategizing and building at the feature level rather than just focusing on outputs.

Our client is a venture capital-backed health tech company transforming the industry's coding practices by creating a marketplace that connects healthcare companies with over 4,000 certified coding specialists. The client is focused on expanding quickly its product, engineering, and design teams with passionate builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment to support its rapid growth.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and build new features and integrations
  • Advance software platform capabilities using Ruby on Rails
  • Develop and support third-party integrations with B2B healthcare systems
  • Provide work estimates for bug fixes, enhancements, and features
  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented code with velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and aid the engineering team with troubleshooting
  • Write and execute unit tests
  • Promote development best practices following team standards with an eye towards innovation and opportunities to scale
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight and a bias towards action as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Become energized by tackling new challenges and eagerly give and receive feedback from colleagues


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience using Ruby on Rails, including version 7+, with a strong background in JavaScript and frameworks (preferably Stimulus)
  • Experience taking the lead on complete features, appropriate to your level, and showing initiative to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience creating and consuming APIs
  • Knowledge of relational / non-relational database systems
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech industry, or growth stage startups

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving
